title: triangulate
body:
## triangulate

Splits every quad and n-gon of a copy of the input mesh into triangles with Blender's Triangulate modifier at its default settings (quads along the shortest diagonal, n-gons by the Beauty method). Use it before wireframe for a triangle cage or to control how polygons are split before export; it has no options.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- STL publication triangulates anyway; add this node only when the triangle layout itself matters.
- The adaptor's recorded native qualification cases cover only a material on a cube; this operation relies on repository examples, not on a recorded qualification case.

Native binding: `triangulate`. Output kind: `["data"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | one node | yes | `data` |

Options: none.
